1. **Keep a consistent sleep schedule.** Go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends. This helps regulate your body's internal clock and makes falling asleep easier over time.

2. **Create a cool, dark, and quiet environment.** Lower your room temperature to around 65–68°F (18–20°C), use blackout curtains or an eye mask, and eliminate noise with earplugs or a white noise machine to signal your brain that it's time to rest.
